steps.content: [Second Bektenov Government] The Second Bektenov Government (Kazakh: Екінші Бектенов үкіметі; Russian: Второе правительство Бектенова) is the 20th government of Kazakhstan led by Prime Minister Oljas Bektenov. It was formed on 31 August 2026 following the resignation of the First Bektenov Government after the 2026 legislative election and the convening of the newly established Kurultai. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev nominated Bektenov for reappointment as prime minister of Kazakhstan, and the Kurultai approved his candidacy. Tokayev subsequently reappointed Bektenov as prime minister and appointed the new government. | other articles: 2026 Kazakh legislative election, 2026

After the legislative election on August 23, 2026, the new government of Kazakhstan was formed under the leadership of Prime Minister Oljas Bektenov. He was reappointed by President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on August 31, 2026, following the election and the establishment of the new unicameral legislature, the Kurultai. 

FINAL: Oljas Bektenov formed the new government of Kazakhstan.

final_answer: Oljas Bektenov formed the new government of Kazakhstan.
